Summary: Server SHALL support search by role parameter on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "Select PractitionerRoles with the specified role"
Context: The Implementation Guide defines a search parameter Plannet_sp_practitionerrole_role that enables searching PractitionerRole resources by the role/code. The parameter is of type token and uses the expression PractitionerRole.code. The parameter supports multipleAnd (parameter may repeat to specify multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (parameter may have multiple values separated by comma where at least one must be true). The allowed modifier is 'text'.

Summary: Support for PractitionerRole period search parameter with multipleOr
Requirement: "The parameter may have multiple values (separated by comma) where at least one must be true"
Context: The practitionerrole-period search parameter allows searching for PractitionerRole resources by period. This requirement specifies that the server must support comma-separated values for the period parameter where at least one value must match (OR logic).

Summary: Server SHALL support specialty search parameter on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "Server SHALL support Parameter `specialty`:`token` [to] Select PractitionerRoles associated with the specified specialty [using Expression] `PractitionerRole.specialty` [with] multipleAnd: The parameter may repeat in order to specify multiple values that must all be true [and] multipleOr: The parameter may have multiple values (separated by comma) where at least one must be true [and] Modifiers Allowed: text"
Context: This requirement defines a token-based search parameter for PractitionerRole resources that allows filtering by specialty. The search parameter supports both AND and OR logic for multiple values and allows text modifiers.

Summary: Health Plan API Actor SHALL support searching PractitionerRole by endpoint parameter
Requirement: "Select PractitionerRoles with the specified endpoint [using] Parameter `endpoint`:`reference` [with] Expression `PractitionerRole.endpoint` [targeting] Endpoint"
Context: The SearchParameter Plannet_sp_practitionerrole_endpoint defines a reference-based search parameter for PractitionerRole resources based on the endpoint element. The parameter supports multipleAnd (multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (multiple comma-separated values where at least one must be true) semantics, with organization chain parameter allowed.

Summary: Health Plan API SHALL support search by service on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "Select PractitionerRoles providing the specified service [using Parameter `service`:`reference` on Resource PractitionerRole with Expression `PractitionerRole.healthcareService`]"
Context: This search parameter allows filtering of PractitionerRole resources by the healthcare service(s) they provide. The parameter supports multipleAnd (multiple values must all be true) and multipleOr (at least one of comma-separated values must be true). Allowed chains include service-category, organization, and location.

Summary: Health Plan API SHALL support search by practitioner on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "Select roles filled by the specified practitioner [using Parameter `practitioner`:`reference` on Resource PractitionerRole with Expression `PractitionerRole.practitioner`]"
Context: This search parameter allows filtering of PractitionerRole resources by the practitioner who fills the role. The parameter supports multipleAnd (multiple values must all be true) and multipleOr (at least one of comma-separated values must be true). Allowed chain includes name.

Summary: Health Plan API SHALL support search by location on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "Select PractitionerRoles available at the specified location [using Parameter `location`:`reference` on Resource PractitionerRole with Expression `PractitionerRole.location`]"
Context: This search parameter allows filtering of PractitionerRole resources by the location(s) where the practitioner provides services. The parameter supports multipleAnd (multiple values must all be true) and multipleOr (at least one of comma-separated values must be true). Allowed chains include address, address-postalcode, address-city, address-state, organization, and type.

Summary: Support search by organization parameter on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "Select PractitionerRoles available at the specified organization [using Parameter `organization`:`reference` with Expression `PractitionerRole.organization`]"
Context: This search parameter allows querying PractitionerRole resources filtered by the Organization reference. The parameter supports multipleAnd (multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (comma-separated values where at least one must be true). Allowed chains include: name, address, partof, type.

Summary: Server SHALL support search by network parameter on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "Select roles where the practitioner is a member of the specified health insurance provider network [using Parameter `network`:`reference` on PractitionerRole resource with Expression `PractitionerRole.extension.where(url='http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/network-reference')`]"
Context: The PractitionerRole resource must support searching by network reference to identify roles where practitioners are members of specific health insurance provider networks. This search parameter uses an extension on the PractitionerRole resource. The parameter supports multipleAnd (multiple values that must all be true) and multipleOr (multiple comma-separated values where at least one must be true). Allowed chains include: name, address, partof, type.

Summary: Network Reference Extension URL Constraint
Requirement: "[The Network Reference extension] url [SHALL be] 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/network-reference'"
Context: The Network Reference extension is used on PractitionerRole resources to reference healthcare provider insurance networks (plannet-Network) that the practitioner participates in through their role. The extension has a fixed URL that must be used when the extension is present.
Actor: Health Plan API Actor, Application Actor
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when the Network Reference extension is used on a PractitionerRole resource.
Section: 11.72.1 Extension: Network Reference - Differential View and Snapshot View

Summary: Network Reference Extension Value Constraint
Requirement: "[The Network Reference extension] value[x] [SHALL be a] Reference([Plan-Net Network])"
Context: When the Network Reference extension is present on a PractitionerRole resource, it must contain a reference to a Plan-Net Network resource. The cardinality is 1..1, meaning exactly one reference must be provided when the extension is used.
Actor: Health Plan API Actor, Application Actor
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when the Network Reference extension is used on a PractitionerRole resource.
Section: 11.72.1 Extension: Network Reference - Differential View and Snapshot View

Summary: Network Reference Extension Nested Extensions Prohibition
Requirement: "[The Network Reference] extension [SHALL have cardinality] 0..0"
Context: The Network Reference extension is a simple extension that does not allow nested extensions. The extension element within the Network Reference extension has a cardinality of 0..0, prohibiting any sub-extensions.
Actor: Health Plan API Actor, Application Actor
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when the Network Reference extension is used on a PractitionerRole resource.
Section: 11.72.1 Extension: Network Reference - Differential View and Snapshot View

Summary: NetworkReference Extension URL Fixed Value
Requirement: "The definition SHALL be a URI for the Structure Definition defining the extension."
Context: The NetworkReference extension must have its url element set to the fixed value 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/network-reference'. This requirement ensures consistent identification of the extension across implementations.
Actor: Health Plan API Actor, Application Actor

Summary: NetworkReference Extension Must Support value[x] Element
Requirement: "[Extension.value[x] has] Must Support [set to] true"
Context: The value[x] element of the NetworkReference extension must be supported by implementations. This element contains a reference to the healthcare provider insurance networks (plannet-Network) that the practitioner participates in through their role. The element has a cardinality of 1..1 and is typed as Reference(Plan-Net Network).
Actor: Health Plan API Actor, Application Actor

Summary: NetworkReference Extension Must Have Either Extensions or Value
Requirement: "Must have either extensions or value[x], not both (extension.exists() != value.exists())"
Context: The NetworkReference extension must conform to the FHIR invariant ext-1, which requires that an extension must have either nested extensions or a value, but not both. This ensures proper structure of the extension element.
Actor: Health Plan API Actor, Application Actor

Summary: Server SHALL support search-type and read interactions on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "A Server SHALL support search-type, read [on PractitionerRole resource]."
Context: This requirement mandates support for search-type and read operations on the PractitionerRole resource.

Summary: Server SHOULD support vread interaction on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "A Server SHOULD support vread [on PractitionerRole resource]."
Context: This requirement recommends support for version-specific read operations on the PractitionerRole resource.

Summary: Server SHALL support returning PractitionerRole resource by id
Requirement: "A Server SHALL be capable of returning a PractitionerRole resource using: GET [base]/PractitionerRole/[id]"
Context: This requirement mandates the ability to retrieve a specific PractitionerRole resource by its logical id.

Summary: Server SHOULD support returning PractitionerRole resource by version id
Requirement: "A Server SHOULD be capable of returning a PractitionerRole resource using: GET [base]/PractitionerRole/[id]/_history/vid"
Context: This requirement recommends the ability to retrieve a specific version of a PractitionerRole resource.

Summary: Server SHALL support _include for PractitionerRole resources
Requirement: "A Server SHALL be capable of supporting the following _includes: PractitionerRole:practitioner, PractitionerRole:organization, PractitionerRole:location, PractitionerRole:service, PractitionerRole:network, PractitionerRole:endpoint"
Context: This requirement mandates support for including referenced Practitioner, Organization, Location, HealthcareService, Network, and Endpoint resources when searching for PractitionerRole resources.

Summary: Server SHALL support search parameters on PractitionerRole resource
Requirement: "A Server SHALL support the following search parameters on PractitionerRole: practitioner, organization, location, service, network, endpoint, role, specialty, _id, _lastUpdated"
Context: This requirement mandates support for searching PractitionerRole resources by practitioner, organization, location, service, network, endpoint, role, specialty, id, and last updated timestamp.

Summary: NewPatients Extension - acceptingPatients value binding requirement
Requirement: "The codes SHALL be taken from [Accepting Patients Codes VS]"
Context: This requirement applies to the acceptingPatients sub-extension of the NewPatients extension. The extension is included in PractitionerRole, HealthcareService, and Location profiles to indicate whether new patients are being accepted in general or from a specific network. The acceptingPatients element uses a CodeableConcept value that must be bound to the AcceptingPatientsVS value set with required binding strength.

Summary: NewPatients Extension - acceptingPatients URL fixed value
Requirement: "The definition SHALL be a URI for the Structure Definition defining the extension."
Context: This requirement applies to the url element of the acceptingPatients sub-extension within the NewPatients extension. The url element must have a fixed value of "acceptingPatients" and the definition must be a URI for the Structure Definition.

Summary: NewPatients Extension - fromNetwork URL fixed value
Requirement: "The definition SHALL be a URI for the Structure Definition defining the extension."
Context: This requirement applies to the url element of the fromNetwork sub-extension within the NewPatients extension. The url element must have a fixed value of "fromNetwork" and the definition must be a URI for the Structure Definition.

Summary: NewPatients Extension - characteristics URL fixed value
Requirement: "The definition SHALL be a URI for the Structure Definition defining the extension."
Context: This requirement applies to the url element of the characteristics sub-extension within the NewPatients extension. The url element must have a fixed value of "characteristics" and the definition must be a URI for the Structure Definition.

Summary: NewPatients Extension - main extension URL fixed value
Requirement: "The definition SHALL be a URI for the Structure Definition defining the extension."
Context: This requirement applies to the main url element of the NewPatients extension. The url element must have a fixed value of "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/newpatients" and the definition must be a URI for the Structure Definition.

Summary: PractitionerRole active element must be true
Requirement: "Whether this practitioner role record is in active use. [PractitionerRole.active] Required Pattern: true"
Context: The PractitionerRole profile requires that the active element be set to true, indicating that the practitioner role record must be in active use. This is a mandatory pattern for the Plan-Net PractitionerRole profile.

Summary: PractitionerRole must have at least one of practitioner, organization, healthcareService, or location
Requirement: "If PlannetPractitionerRole.practitioner is absent (PlannetPractitionerRole.organization, PlannetPractitionerRole.healthcareservice, PlannetPractitionerRole.location) must be present: practitioner.exists() or (organization.exists() or healthcareService.exists() or location.exists())"
Context: The PractitionerRole resource must include at least one reference to either a Practitioner, Organization, HealthcareService, or Location to establish the context of the role. This constraint ensures that the role has sufficient context for understanding who or what entity is performing the role.
Conditionality Details: This requirement is in force when the practitioner element is absent

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification extension status must be 'active'
Requirement: "Value of extension [PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:status.value[x]] Binding: Qualification Status VS (required) Fixed Value: active"
Context: When the qualification extension is used in the PractitionerRole resource, the status sub-extension must have a fixed value of 'active', indicating that the qualification is currently valid and in force.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when the qualification extension is present

Summary: PractitionerRole telecom.system must be present
Requirement: "Telecommunications form for contact point - what communications system is required to make use of the contact. [PractitionerRole.telecom.system] 1.1 [required]"
Context: When telecom contact information is provided for a PractitionerRole, the system element must be specified to indicate the type of telecommunications system (phone, fax, email, etc.) required to use the contact point.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when telecom is present

Summary: PractitionerRole telecom.value must be present
Requirement: "The actual contact point details, in a form that is meaningful to the designated communication system (i.e. phone number or email address). [PractitionerRole.telecom.value] 1.1"
Context: When telecom contact information is provided for a PractitionerRole, the value element must be specified with the actual contact point details (e.g., phone number, email address) in a format appropriate for the specified system.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when telecom is present

Summary: PractitionerRole notAvailable description must be present
Requirement: "The reason that can be presented to the user as to why this time is not available. [PractitionerRole.notAvailable.description] 1.1"
Context: When the notAvailable element is used to indicate a period when the practitioner is not available, a description must be provided explaining the reason for the unavailability to users.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when notAvailable is present

Summary: PractitionerRole must have contact information or reference to an Endpoint
Requirement: "SHALL have contact information or a reference to an Endpoint [constraint pd-1]"
Context: The PractitionerRole resource must include either telecom contact information or a reference to an Endpoint resource to ensure that there is a means of contacting or connecting to services related to this practitioner role.

Summary: PractitionerRole must have practitioner, organization, healthcare service, or location
Requirement: "SHALL have a practitioner, an organization, a healthcare service, or a location [constraint us-core-13]"
Context: This is a US Core constraint requiring that the PractitionerRole must reference at least one of: practitioner, organization, healthcare service, or location. This ensures the role has sufficient context within the US healthcare system.

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification extension code element is required
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification] Slices for extension: extension:code 1.1 [required]"
Context: When the qualification extension is used, the code sub-extension must be present with cardinality 1..1, specifying the type of qualification using a CodeableConcept bound to the IndividualSpecialtyAndDegreeLicenseCertificateVS value set.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when the qualification extension is present

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification extension status element is required
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification] Slices for extension: extension:status 1.1 [required]"
Context: When the qualification extension is used, the status sub-extension must be present with cardinality 1..1, indicating the status of the qualification with a fixed value of 'active'.
Conditionality Details: This requirement applies when the qualification extension is present

Summary: PractitionerRole SHALL have contact information or reference to Endpoint
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole] SHALL have contact information or a reference to an Endpoint (`telecom.exists() or endpoint.exists()`)"
Context: This is an invariant constraint (pd-1) on the PractitionerRole resource requiring that contact information be provided either through the telecom element or through a reference to an Endpoint resource. This ensures practitioners can be contacted through their role.
Section: 11.65.1 Resource Profile: PlannetPractitionerRole - Detailed Descriptions, Invariant pd-1

Summary: PractitionerRole SHALL have practitioner, organization, healthcare service, or location
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole] SHALL have a practitioner, an organization, a healthcare service, or a location. (`practitioner.exists() or organization.exists() or healthcareService.exists() or location.exists()`)"
Context: This is an invariant constraint (us-core-13) on the PractitionerRole resource requiring that at least one of the four key reference elements be present. This ensures the role is associated with appropriate entities.
Section: 11.65.1 Resource Profile: PlannetPractitionerRole - Detailed Descriptions, Invariant us-core-13

Summary: PractitionerRole practitioner or organization/healthcareservice/location must be present
Requirement: "If PlannetPractitionerRole.practitioner is absent ( PlannetPractitionerRole.organization, PlannetPractitionerRole.healthcareservice, PlannetPractitionerRole.location) must be present (`practitioner.exists() or (organization.exists() or healthcareService.exists() or location.exists())`)"
Context: This is an invariant constraint (practitioner-or-organization-or-healthcareservice-or-location) that provides an alternative formulation requiring that if practitioner is not present, at least one of organization, healthcareService, or location must be present.
Conditionality Details: If practitioner is absent, then organization, healthcareService, or location must be present
Section: 11.65.1 Resource Profile: PlannetPractitionerRole - Detailed Descriptions, Invariant practitioner-or-organization-or-healthcareservice-or-location

Summary: PractitionerRole.active must be true
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.active] must be true (Pattern Value `true`)"
Context: The active element is constrained to have a pattern value of true, indicating that PractitionerRole resources returned by the API must represent active roles. This is a Must Support element with cardinality 1..1.
Section: 11.65.1 Resource Profile: PlannetPractitionerRole - Detailed Descriptions, PractitionerRole.active

Summary: PractitionerRole.telecom.system is required when telecom is present
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.telecom.system] is required with cardinality 1..1 [when telecom element is present]"
Context: When contact details are provided in the telecom element, the system (phone, fax, email, etc.) must be specified. This is a Must Support element indicating the telecommunications form.
Section: 11.65.1 Resource Profile: PlannetPractitionerRole - Detailed Descriptions, PractitionerRole.telecom.system

Summary: PractitionerRole.telecom.value is required when telecom is present
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.telecom.value] is required with cardinality 1..1 [when telecom element is present]"
Context: When contact details are provided in the telecom element, the actual contact point value (phone number, email address, etc.) must be provided. This is a Must Support element.
Section: 11.65.1 Resource Profile: PlannetPractitionerRole - Detailed Descriptions, PractitionerRole.telecom.value

Summary: PractitionerRole.notAvailable.description is required when notAvailable is present
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.notAvailable.description] is required with cardinality 1..1 [when notAvailable element is present]"
Context: When specifying times the practitioner is not available in their role, a description explaining the reason must be provided. This is a Must Support element.
Section: 11.65.1 Resource Profile: PlannetPractitionerRole - Detailed Descriptions, PractitionerRole.notAvailable.description

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification extension code is required
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:code] is required with cardinality 1..1 [when qualification extension is present]"
Context: When using the qualification extension to specify qualifications for a practitioner role, the code element identifying the type of qualification must be provided. This is a Must Support element.

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification extension status is required
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:status] is required with cardinality 1..1 [when qualification extension is present]"
Context: When using the qualification extension, the status of the qualification must be specified. This is a Must Support element with a fixed value of 'active'.

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification status must be 'active'
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:status.value[x]] must have Fixed Value `active`"
Context: The status value within the qualification extension is constrained to the fixed value 'active', indicating only active qualifications should be represented.

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification extension identifier value must be Identifier type
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:identifier.value[x]] is required with cardinality 1..1 and Type [Identifier] [when identifier extension is present]"
Context: When providing an identifier for a qualification, it must be of type Identifier with cardinality 1..1.

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification code value must be CodeableConcept
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:code.value[x]] is required with cardinality 1..1 and Type [CodeableConcept] [when code extension is present]"
Context: The qualification code value must be of type CodeableConcept and is bound to the Individual Specialties, Degrees, Licenses, and Certificates value set with extensible binding.

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification issuer value must reference Plan-Net Organization
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:issuer.value[x]] is required with cardinality 1..1 and Type [Reference(Plan-Net Organization)] [when issuer extension is present]"
Context: When specifying the issuer of a qualification, it must be a reference to a Plan-Net Organization resource.

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification status value must be code type
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:status.value[x]] is required with cardinality 1..1 and Type [code] [when status extension is present]"
Context: The status value must be of type code and bound to the Qualification Status value set with required binding strength.

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification period value must be Period type
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:period.value[x]] is required with cardinality 1..1 and Type [Period] [when period extension is present]"
Context: When specifying the validity period of a qualification, it must be of type Period.

Summary: PractitionerRole qualification whereValid value must be CodeableConcept or Reference
Requirement: "[PractitionerRole.extension:qualification.extension:whereValid.value[x]] is required with cardinality 1..1 and Type [Choice of: CodeableConcept, Reference(Plan-Net Location)] [when whereValid extension is present]"
Context: When specifying where a qualification is valid, it must be either a CodeableConcept (bound to USPS state codes) or a reference to a Plan-Net Location.
